intro.h2: One artisan with every trade under his eye
paragraphs: JC Custom Cabinets handles kitchen remodeling in Temecula, CA the way a furniture maker would. Owner Joel Cervantes designs the layout, builds the cabinetry and supervises every phase himself. You talk to the person whose hands are on your project, not a sales rep or a stack of disconnected subcontractors.

Because he controls design, fabrication and installation, his crew can take a kitchen down to the studs. On a Meadowview Estates remodel they moved interior walls, raised the ceiling, rerouted gas, water and electrical lines and swapped small windows for panoramic ones. When the budget is tight, Joel offers quality prefab cabinets from a local maker.

services.h2: Kitchen remodeling in Temecula and the rooms around it

items.name: Full Kitchen Remodels
items.blurb: Turnkey work from layout to appliances: wall and window changes, plumbing and electrical updates, tile backsplashes, lighting and new flooring. Joel personally handles design, fabrication and installation, so cabinets, counters and trim fit the way they were drawn.

image.alt: Crowne Hill Estates kitchen in Temecula with white Shaker cabinets, quartzite counters and an oversized island wrapped in reclaimed lumber

items.name: Custom and Prefab Cabinetry
items.blurb: Handcrafted cabinets built to your layout, or high-quality prefabricated Shaker cabinets from a trusted local manufacturer when the budget is tight. Prefab units get custom finessing and accents, so the finished run reads as one built-in piece.

image.alt: White Shaker kitchen in Temecula with frosted glass uppers, black chimney hood, quartz island and black saddle stools

items.name: Bathroom Remodeling
items.blurb: Master suites and vanity overhauls from concept to completion: tile walls and floors, electrical rewiring, fixture placement, frameless glass showers and custom storage. Vanities range from prefab white Shaker units with Bianco Swan quartz to fully custom double vanities.

image.alt: Temecula bathroom with white Shaker double vanity, black hardware, framed mirrors and a frameless glass shower in marble-look tile

items.name: Built-Ins and Media Walls
items.blurb: Media walls, fireplace cabinetry, home office bookcases, closet systems, mudroom benches, laundry rooms and dining buffets, finished with accent lighting, framing and clean wire management. Recent built-ins went into homes in Temecula, Murrieta, Riverside and La Cresta.

image.alt: Custom white Shaker entertainment center with open side shelving built for a Temecula client

items.name: ADU Interiors
items.blurb: For a Temecula Wine Country ADU, Joel designed, built and installed the kitchen, bathroom, laundry room and a cabinetry nook. The finish: golden-toned birch Shaker cabinets, brushed gold hardware and Calacatta De Oro quartz with a 2-inch square edge.

image.alt: Temecula Wine Country ADU kitchen with golden-toned birch Shaker cabinets, brushed gold pulls, Calacatta De Oro quartz and a farmhouse sink

items.title: You talk to the builder
items.text: Joel is the designer, the cabinetmaker and the lead on site. Reviewers call him a master carpenter who can build anything, and one wrote that the price quoted was the price paid.

items.title: Licensed, in business since 2015
items.text: JC Custom Cabinets, LLC holds California license #1038035. Joel started as an apprentice and has more than 20 years in the trade.

items.title: Fewer markups
items.text: Design, carpentry, tile, plumbing and electrical stay under Joel's supervision, which he says removes subcontractor markups. Google reviewers often mention his fair pricing.

about.h2: Meet Joel Cervantes, owner and craftsman
about.text: Cabinetry has been Joel Cervantes's lifelong passion. He started as an apprentice when he was young, spent more than 20 years in the trade, and has run JC Custom Cabinets since 2015. As owner, designer and craftsman, he plans each layout, builds the cabinets and directs a trusted crew of specialists on site. His aim is to add hundreds of thoughtful details so the room fits your style and the way you live. He offers a free consultation in your home, and the business serves clients in Spanish too.

image.alt: Black and white portrait of Joel Cervantes, owner of JC Custom Cabinets in Temecula

process.h2: How a JC Custom Cabinets project comes together

steps.title: Free in-home consultation
steps.text: Joel meets you at home, for a small project or a large one, to look at the space and talk through layout, cabinet options and budget.

steps.title: Design and written contract
steps.text: He designs the layout and puts materials, costs, timeline and any outside tradespeople into a professional written contract before work begins.

steps.title: Cabinet fabrication
steps.text: Custom cabinets are built to your layout, or quality prefab units from a local cabinetmaker are prepared with custom details to match.

steps.title: Build and install
steps.text: Under Joel's supervision the crew handles walls, gas, plumbing, electrical, tile, flooring and lighting, then installs appliances, fixtures and hardware.

service_area.h2: Southwest Riverside County, close to home
service_area.text: JC Custom Cabinets is based in Temecula and works across southwest Riverside County. The portfolio includes homes in Meadowview Estates, Crowne Hill Estates, Temeku Hills and Temecula Wine Country, plus built-ins and remodels for clients in Murrieta, Menifee, Wildomar, Riverside and La Cresta. Testimonials also come from Moreno Valley. Call Joel to ask whether your neighborhood is in range for a visit.

faq.h2: Temecula kitchen questions, answered by the craftsman

items.q: Do you build custom cabinets or install stock ones?
items.a: Both. Joel designs, builds and installs fully custom cabinets for kitchens, baths, entertainment centers, laundry rooms and closets. When the budget is tight, he offers quality prefabricated cabinets from a trusted local manufacturer and adds custom touches, like a wine rack sized so wall and base cabinets line up.

items.q: Can your crew move walls, plumbing and gas lines?
items.a: Yes. The crew handles structural wall and window changes and reroutes natural gas, water and electrical lines under Joel's supervision. On one Meadowview Estates kitchen they also raised the ceiling and added panoramic windows, then installed the cabinets, quartzite counters and appliances.

Yes. Joel offers a free in-home consultation and estimate for projects small or large. Call (951) 816-7809 to set a time. He will look at your space, talk through layout and cabinet options, and explain which parts of the job his own team will handle.

items.q: Can we plan the project in Spanish?
items.a: Yes. The contact page says "Se habla español," so you can plan your kitchen, bath or built-in project in Spanish or English. The business also identifies as Latino-owned on its Google profile, and it serves families across Temecula, Murrieta and Menifee.

items.q: Will you build cabinets outside the kitchen?
items.a: Yes. Joel builds media walls, fireplace cabinets, home office bookcases, closet systems, mudroom benches, laundry room cabinets and dining room buffets. Prefab units are often blended with custom pieces, and media walls can include accent lighting, framing and clean wire management for the TV.

final_cta.h2: Talk directly with the craftsman who will build it
final_cta.text: Call Joel at (951) 816-7809 to book a free in-home consultation and estimate. Se habla español.
